headings: PUMPKIN SPICE LONG SCENTED CANDLE PACK (PACK OF 12)

jsonld_raw.name: PUMPKIN SPICE LONG SCENTED CANDLE PACK (PACK OF 12)
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candles with a slender, elongated cylindrical design.

Pumpkin Spice | An invitation to your deepest memories. Warm, surprising spices reveal a delicious sweet pumpkin accord intertwined with creamy notes of sandalwood and cashmere.

Notes:
Top notes: Citrus, Nutmeg
Heart notes: Pumpkin.
Base notes: Cinnamon, Spices, Cashmeran, Dry wood

The pack includes 12 candles in different colors.
